articles.title: NASA Drops Nearly $600M on Four Lunar Missions to Kickstart Moon Base
articles.summary: NASA is accelerating its Moon Base Program with four new CLPS missions in 2028, awarding $600M to Astrobotic, Firefly, and Intuitive Machines. A cookie-sized laser reflector will serve as a permanent navigation marker.

articles.title: First-Ever Magnetic Map of a Pulsar Reveals a Cosmic Particle Highway
articles.summary: Using NASA's IXPE telescope, astronomers directly mapped the magnetic field around pulsar PSR J1101−6101 for the first time. They confirmed particles stream along magnetic field lines—and found the field is surprisingly orderly.

articles.title: Embedded T. rex Tooth Reveals Face-to-Face Attack 66 Million Years Ago
articles.summary: A nearly complete Edmontosaurus skull with a broken T. rex tooth lodged in its face offers rare evidence of predatory behavior. CT scans suggest a face-to-face attack with deadly force.
